user.title: Connect your Pluxee account
user.description:
**Recommended — connect with just your session cookie** (no callback URL needed):

1. Open the Pluxee login link in your normal browser and keep Developer Tools open (press **F12**) while you log in. Complete the email, captcha, and one-time code steps. If you are already logged in, continue with step 2.
2. In Developer Tools, keep the **Network** tab open and filter the request list for `connect.pluxee.app`. Open a request to that domain, select its **Cookies** tab, and copy the `op_session*` request cookies (`op_session`, `op_session.sig`, `op_session.legacy`, `op_session.legacy.sig`). Do not copy cookies for `api.pluxee.app`.
3. Paste the copied rows into the **Session cookie** field below and submit. Leave the callback URL empty.

*Alternative (callback URL):* open the login link {auth_url}, log in, and copy the full address-bar URL that starts with `.../oidc/callback?code=...`.

data.callback_url: Callback URL (optional — leave empty if you pasted the cookie)

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Pluxee
reauth_confirm.description:
Your Pluxee session expired. **Recommended:** open the Pluxee login link in your browser and keep Developer Tools open (press **F12**) while you log in again. In Developer Tools, keep the **Network** tab open and filter the request list for `connect.pluxee.app`. Open a request to that domain, select its **Cookies** tab, copy the `op_session*` request cookies, and paste them into the **Session cookie** field below. Leave the callback URL empty.

*Alternative:* open this link {auth_url}, log in, and paste the resulting `.../oidc/callback?code=...` URL.

error.no_code: Nothing to authenticate with. Paste your session cookie (the `op_session*` rows for `connect.pluxee.app`) — or, if using the callback method, the whole URL that contains `code=`.
error.invalid_auth: Login failed or the code expired. Open the link again, log in and paste the new URL quickly.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Pluxee. Please try again.
error.session_cookie_invalid: The session cookie is not valid (no `op_session`, wrong format, or expired). Keep Developer Tools open, filter the **Network** requests for `connect.pluxee.app`, open a matching request, select its **Cookies** tab, and copy the `op_session*` request cookies. Or leave the field empty to continue without it.
